title: Today view
lead: A non-technical member's default screen: tonight's dinner, mark it made, and a link to the list (P1, P3, U2).
boundary: **Not in this slice:** notifications; pantry nudges.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: This is the screen everyday users actually use. It must be readable at a glance and need one tap at most.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body:
1. What else, if anything, belongs on it: tomorrow's dinner? A "defrost tonight" hint (needs a recipe flag)?
2. Label wording ("Made it" / "Skip tonight")?

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Query today's planned meal; render the title, a link to the recipe, and the made/skip buttons.
2. "Made" records history (used by recency); "skip" applies the ADR 0013 rule.
3. Add a link or button to the shopping list.
4. Set as the PWA `start_url`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - Tests pass; a non-technical household member can use it unassisted in a hallway test (the owner observes).

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
